description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Directs for Hand Sanitizers
reasoning: This gazette contains a regulatory direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes mandatory requirements for the import, manufacture, and sale of hand sanitizers, specifically requiring registration with the National Medicines Regulatory Authority. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5).
